package.name: perception_head_pipe
package.description: Head-camera pipe-opening top-center estimator. Consumes pre-validated pipe_opening detections and publishes one 3D top-opening center per opening as geometry_msgs/PoseArray in base_link. Uses an annulus (outer-inner ellipse) ring around each opening to sample rim depth, fits a plane, and intersects the opening-center ray with it (median-depth fallback). Assumes head RGB and aligned depth share the same pixel grid. Used by mission C sequential assembly.
